changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE entry_draft ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), company_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, source_type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('XML','IMAGE','PDF','TEXT')), source_file_id UUID REFERENCES uploaded_file(id), source_text TEXT, voucher_type VARCHAR(30), extracted_data JSONB NOT NULL, field_confidence JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', suggested_entries JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', validation JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', status VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','VALIDATED','CONFIRMED','DISCARDED')), created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES app_user(id), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ); CREATE INDEX idx_entry_draft_user ON entry_draft (created_by, created_at DESC);
